rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP via the tool, reviewed the user’s orders, and correctly identified the delivered laptop with 32GB RAM. It presented an available replacement variant matching the user’s requested specs (i7/8GB/1TB), explicitly restated the exact change, and obtained confirmation before executing the exchange. The tool action targeted the correct order and item, and the result showed the exchange requested with a refund of $60.78 to the stored card; the agent relayed this accurately. Minor notes: the statement about exchanges only once per order and the promise of an email are not explicitly supported by the tools, but they did not affect the correctness of the performed exchange. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
